answer: A reputation bond works like a jade seal on an ivory ledger: before an agent can join the market, it must lock a stake that only matures after a long voyage of honest work. Creating a fake identity is cheap, but funding and aging thousands of bonded identities is not. If an agent cheats, its bond is slashed, so a sybil attacker must pay the full price of every fake persona upfront, turning identity farming into a losing trade.
